fullPassage: One valuable technique for getting out of helplessness, depression, and situations which are predominantly being run by the thought, "I can't," is to choose to be with other persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle. This is one of the great powers of self-help groups. When we are in a negative state, we have given a lot of energy to negative thought forms, and the positive thought forms are weak. Those who are in a higher vibration are free of the energy from their negative thoughts and have energized positive thought forms. Merely to be in their presence is beneficial. In some self-help groups, this is called "hanging out with the winners." The benefit here is on the psychic level of consciousness, and there is a transfer of positive energy and relighting of one's own latent positive thought forms.

questions.passage: One valuable technique for getting out of helplessness, depression, and situations which are predominantly being run by the thought, "I can't," is to choose to be with other persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle. This is one of the great powers of self-help groups. When we are in a negative state, we have given a lot of energy to negative thought forms, and the positive thought forms are weak. Those who are in a higher vibration are free of the energy from <u>their</u> negative thoughts and have energized positive thought forms. Merely to be in their presence is beneficial. In some self-help groups, this is called "hanging out with the winners." The benefit here is on the psychic level of consciousness, and there is a transfer of positive energy and relighting of one's own latent positive thought forms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 their가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 their가 가리키는 대상은 '높은 진동 상태에 있는 사람들'이다.
det.analysis:
① 높은 진동 상태에 있는 사람들 ←정답: Those who are in a higher vibration이 자신의 부정적 생각에서 자유로움
② 무기력에 빠진 사람들: 문맥상 주어가 아님
③ 집단의 운영자들: 언급되지 않음
④ 부정적 사고 형태 자체: 소유격이 가리키는 사람이 아님
det.tip: their negative thoughts의 소유 주체가 누구인지 확인한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 긍정적 사고가 약해지는 것은 우리가 '부정적인(negative)' 상태에 있을 때이다.
det.analysis:
① creative(창의적인): 긍정적 사고가 약해지는 맥락과 무관
② grateful(감사하는): 문맥과 반대
③ negative(부정적인) ←정답: 부정적 상태에서 부정적 사고에 에너지를 쏟고 긍정적 사고는 약해짐
④ confident(자신 있는): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 빈칸 뒤 '긍정적 사고가 약하다'는 결과에서 상태를 추론한다.

(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '우리가 씨름하는 그 문제'는 the problem with which we struggle이다.
det.analysis: 본문: 'persons who have resolved the problem with which we struggle'에서 목적어 부분의 영작이다. 전치사 with + 관계대명사 which를 이용한 「with which + 주어 + 자동사」 구조이다.
det.tip: 전치사 with를 관계대명사 which 앞에 두는 어순을 확인한다.
